name: System Administrator
summary: Manages models, local storage, recovery, exports, and release safety.
description: Configures and governs a Callweave installation for a location or deployment target. Owns policy versions, allowed source sets, and operational safeguards so the standalone capabilities can execute with explicit configuration instead of hidden workflow assumptions.

distinguished_from.how: Defines configuration and guardrails for the installation rather than executing the capability graph itself.
Administers the deployment and policy envelope broadly, while the location owner focuses on local ecological scope and source facts for a specific place.
